about_the_game:
Dragon Eclipse ARENA Demo is a peek of what we want the full version to be: the ultimate auto-battler deckbuilding experience. Earn the right to call yourself a master Tamer by creating a powerful deck, figuring out amazing synergies, and beating all difficulty levels!

Start the game by picking your Tamer, each with a unique ability impacting the gameplay. Once you do that, it’s time to craft your deck. Every run, you’ll be presented with a shuffled choice of cards, adding more variety to the game.

Test your squad in combat by taking auto-battles on a 3x3 grid, where the positioning and synergy of your Mystlings are key. Focus on what suits you best: columns, rows, isolated spots, or a mixture of all. Match 3 identical Mystlings to evolve them into stronger forms, unlocking new abilities and unleashing new powerful attacks!

Use the gold you gather to get stronger. Trim your deck or buy boosters to get new cards. Acquire Blessings, global boosts that last through the run. Find out your favorite combos, wipe bosses with ease, and overcome the incoming eclipse!

Please note that this demo version is a vertical slice. That being said, you will only experience a small bit of content that is planned for the full game. At the same time, the general gameplay loop and formula are similar to what will be in the final version.

Here are more details about the content available in this demo:

  • 18 Mystlings (each able to evolve into a stronger form)

  • 31 Blessings (permanent buffs)

  • 21 skill cards

  • 2 Tamers

  • 6 regular enemy types

  • 5 powerful boss enemies

short_description: Experience an auto-battler deckbuilder that combines clever 3x3 grid positioning, tactical combat, and powerful synergies. For each run, draft a new starting deck and choose a unique Tamer. Use Blessings to get mighty permanent buffs, evolve magical Mystlings, and achieve victory!
